request.query: An additive valuation of a determinant is at least the minimum over permutations of the sum of the valuations of entries

items.name: AddValuation.map_le_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} {Γ₀ : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] (v : AddValuation R Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_6} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → R} {g : Γ₀}, (∀ i ∈ s, g ≤ v (f i)) → g ≤ v (∑ i ∈ s, f i)

items.name: AddValuation.map_add'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} {Γ₀ : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] (v : AddValuation R Γ₀)
  (x y : R), v x ≤ v (x + y) ∨ v y ≤ v (x + y)

items.name: AddValuation.map_add
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} {Γ₀ : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] (v : AddValuation R Γ₀)
  (x y : R), min (v x) (v y) ≤ v (x + y)

items.name: AddValuation
items.type: (R : Type u_3) → [Ring R] → (Γ₀ : Type u_4) → [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] → Type (max u_3 u_4)

items.name: AddValuation.of
items.type:
{R : Type u_3} →
  {Γ₀ : Type u_4} →
    [inst : Ring R] →
      [inst_1 : LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] →
        (f : R → Γ₀) →
          f 0 = ⊤ →
            f 1 = 0 →
              (∀ (x y : R), min (f x) (f y) ≤ f (x + y)) → (∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) = f x + f y) → AddValuation R Γ₀

items.name: AddValuation.map_lt_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} {Γ₀ : Type u_4} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] (v : AddValuation R Γ₀)
  {ι : Type u_6} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → R} {g : Γ₀}, g ≠ ⊤ → (∀ i ∈ s, g < v (f i)) → g < v (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
